title: Podcast Of The Week: The Football Ramble
content:
Available to download weekly, The Football Ramble podcast is a must listen for the discerning football fan with an equal sense of intrigue and fun. Started in 2007, ‘The Ramble’ has grown rapidly to become a renowned and respected opinion-former as well as a contributor to a variety of media outlets, including the BBC, Sky, ESPN, and FourFourTwo magazine.

Regular features include ‘The Dean Windass Hall of Fame’— a feature that looks at legendary players or teams from the past in great detail (our favourites were profiles on Eusebio, Dennis Bergkamp, St Pauli, FK Start), funny stories from around the world, opening questions like ‘Who is your favourite pony-tailed footballer?’ and ‘What was your first ever football kit?’ along with a general catch up and discussion on recent football events. In our opinion, the best thing about this podcast is how the views and opinions are honest with the ‘say what you’re thinking’ style meaning that there is no tip-toeing around certain subjects like many on-screen pundits have to.

With well over six million lifetime downloads, coupled with a sizeable and vibrant social media presence, the podcast affirms The Ramble’s position as the biggest independent voice in football in the UK.

The podcast can be downloaded from their brilliant website www.thefootballramble.com and is complemented by a fantastic range of football features and blogs.
